entities.name: Zdeněk Rytíř
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zdeněk Rytíř was a Czech composer, lyricist, multi-instrumentalist, and singer born in Tábor, at the time part of the Nazi-occupied Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia. He died of a heart attack at age 69, in Prague.
